spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Virtuous, good, respectable.
2 Kind, benevolent.
m. (-नः)
The charioteer of INDRA.
E.
सु good, and जन person.

f. (-ता)
1 Goodness, benevolence.
2 A number of respectable persons.
E.
सुजन, and तल् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Kindness, benevolence.
E.
त्व added to सुजन.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
Legitimate, of respectable birth.
E.
सु, and जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having clear or sweet water.
n. (-लं)
Good water.
E.
सु, and जल water.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Of a good tribe or species.
E.
सु, and जाति tribe.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Well-digested.
2 Decayed, worn out.
E.
सु, and जीर्ण digested.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Lived well or to some purpose.
n. (-तं)
A lucky or happy life.
E.
सु well, जीवित living.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well or easily known.
E.
सु, and ज्ञात known.
